fields.product: Listed dispersant, 36 barrels; product on the NCP Product Schedule
fields.zone: Heron Bay entrance, about 1.5 mi from shore, depth 12 to 18 ft (outside the area plan's preauthorization zone)
fields.situation: Diesel, about 4,200 bbl released, 10 hours on the water. Wind SE 12 kt, seas 1 to 2 ft. Sheen with metallic patches is 1.8 mi from the marsh mouth and moving NW at about 0.4 kt.
fields.justification: Mechanical recovery has reached about 12 percent of the estimated volume. The request proposes dispersant on the leading edge to reduce the oil reaching the marsh.
fields.monitoring: Special Monitoring of Applied Dispersants and Efficacy (SMART) Tier 1 team on station before the first sortie. Stop on any wildlife concentration in the zone. Aircraft crews briefed by the Safety Officer.
fields.decision: Not approved 1115. The zone is outside the preauthorization zone in the area plan (at least 3 nautical miles from shore and 10 m deep), so use here would need incident-specific concurrence of the EPA and state RRT representatives. The SSC advises that diesel is light, much of it evaporates and disperses naturally within a day or two, and dispersant in shallow water by the marsh adds little benefit. Continue protective booming and skimming. RRT briefed 1102. Signed: FOSC Lt. Cmdr. R. Alvarez; State OSC concurs.
